correctness.rationale: The actual 70 original tetrahedra in facets.txt produce \(f=(14,84,140,70)\) and a connected graph with 71 non-tree cycle generators. Independently forming all 140 oriented triangular boundary relations and computing the full integral Smith normal form gives one nonunit invariant \(4\), hence \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z/4\), strengthening the source verifier\'s determinant-index argument. An independent mod-four cocycle construction annihilates every face boundary and gives 143 missing-three-clique residues: \(50\) equal 1, \(38\) equal 2, \(55\) equal 3 and none zero. This exhausts all 283 3-cliques (140 face, 143 missing). Every face triangle is nullhomologous and simple cycles have at least three edges, so these are exactly the minimum-length nonzero integral cycles. All computations were performed on the actual pinned facet blob, not the verification log.

value.rationale: A complete list of integral-homology shortest simple cycles and their torsion orders in a standard low-vertex lens-space triangulation is a natural invariant-level combinatorial topology fact. It distinguishes primitive from order-two 3-cycles, and the exact exhaustive spectrum is not obtained merely from knowing the ambient group \(\mathbb Z/4\) and the face vector.

final_claim: For Lutz\'s exact 14-vertex 70-tetrahedron triangulation of \(L(4,1)\), \(H_1(K;\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z/4\), exactly \(143\) empty three-cliques are all nonzero integral-homology cycles, \(105\) represent order-four classes and \(38\) the order-two class, so the simple integral-homology \(1\)-systole equals \(3\) and those triangles are exactly all minimizers.
limitations: This is a finite integral-homology and simple-edge combinatorial census of one labelled triangulation, not a free-homotopy or Riemannian-length result.
The orientation-dependent residue split \(50\) versus \(55\) is not an intrinsic unoriented distribution.
